Robert Frost (1874–1963).  Miscellaneous Poems to 1920.  1920.

11. Plowmen

(From 
A Miscellany of American Poetry 1920
 [New York, 1920].)

I 
HEAR
 men say to plow the snow.
They cannot mean to plant it, though—
Unless in bitterness to mock
At having cultivated rock.
